notes:
Summary: Springhaven (mid-market CX SaaS) currently uses OpenAI for chat + embeddings; evaluating Redwood Hosted as immediate migration path and Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost. They are price-sensitive but need clear parity on prompt outputs and no regressions on top support intents.

Key pain points: cost of high-volume embeddings, tail latency for multi-turn support flows, and security/regulatory needs for customer PII. They need SAML/Okta + audit logs + KMS.

POC plan: 2-week hosted POC (Mar 25 - Apr 8) using a 5k-message test corpus (support threads) + embedding/semantic search benchmark. Follow-on Dedicated sizing POC (4-6 weeks) to validate throughput and caching.

Technical requirements / targets:
- Chat latency target: p95 <= 250ms for short-turn support replies (50-150 tokens)
- Embedding throughput: 800+ QPS during business hours for search, cost target 40% below current provider
- Model parity: outputs must match current prompts within acceptable drift; QA regression set of ~200 golden prompts used for nightly checks
- Routing: primary hosted, fallback to smaller/cheaper model if capacity constrained; want compatibility layer for OpenAI-style endpoints

Recent quotes (paraphrased):
- "We need parity across our top 50 prompts — regressions are a showstopper." — Head of ML Ops
- "If Redwood can prove 30-40% cost savings at comparable quality we can commit to Dedicated." — VP Product

Risk & blockers: prompt-engineering gap (templating differences), mismatch in tokenization causing small BUT visible changes in outputs, legal needs to review MSA, SAML integration and VPC peering timeline unknown.

Next steps noted: AE to deliver updated Dedicated pricing by 2025-04-24; SE to run a 2-day prompt-parity focused micro-POC (sample 200 prompts) and report diffs; Security to complete SAML test with Okta staging account; schedule Dedicated sizing + infra call for week of 2025-05-05.
